items.title: Artells Media Awards
items.summary: Upload up to 2 works per round to a creator profile at artellsmedia.com; the community rates the work blind on a 5-star scale, and an editor's star counts five times. The top three get a magazine cover in print (Artells, Artego, or Figgi, Quadro and Marika).

items.title: 2 Minutes for Peace – International Open Call for Short Videos
items.summary: 2 Minutes for Peace is an international open call inviting people worldwide to share a short video expressing what peace means to them. Through storytelling, images, words, music, or everyday moments, create a video of up to two minutes reflecting on peace, dialogue, coexistence, solidarity, and hope.
